patch.summary:
Choose Switcher Studio only if your buying job matches “Multi-camera live video production and multistreaming for Mac/iOS marketers — Studio Seaso” rather than Uniqode's shape. Choose Uniqode only if your buying job matches “Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR;” rather than Switcher Studio's shape. Workflow advantage: Switcher Studio leans creator-marketing; Uniqode leans lead-generation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
